figures.caption: Fig. 1. Inference pipeline. Task type is dispatched deterministically, and one retrievalexcluded TF–IDF bank is used three ways: (1) an option-aware decision prior ŷret, cret for the MCQ confidence gate; (2) k in-prompt retrieved examples for both adapted VLMs (k = 1 during adapter training, k = 3 in the submitted runtime); (3) a retrievalbacked fallback answer (dashed), only when OE generation violates the output contract.

Table 1. Performance on H220 (200 MCQ, 20 OE): MCQ accuracy and OE tokenF1/RaTEScore [14]. Rows 2–3 have no OE result because option scoring requires candidate answers; row 1 uses the nearest retrieved answer for OE. Rows 6–9 keep the task-specific adapters fixed and vary only k, isolating inference-time context and gating. Predictions are deterministic across reruns. The ± values are bootstrap standard deviations (10,000 resamples), not confidence intervals. Bold indicates the best point estimate per column.
